edited: Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Use the mean across all nonmissing ownership records as the comparison average.

Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Use the unweighted mean of all timing-group means as the comparison average.

Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? Ignoring missing ownership values, give in one row the mean of those timings' average ownership and how far above average they are on average, without rounding. Use the mean of nonmissing ownership records with known timing as the comparison average.

Looking at announcement timing (`eventannotm`, with a missing timing as its own group), which timings have an average institutional ownership strictly above average? queries:
WITH timing_averages AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
)
SELECT
  AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_timing_ownership,
  AVG(t.avg_ownership - o.avg_ownership) AS mean_above_average
FROM timing_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE t.avg_ownership > o.avg_ownership

WITH timing_means AS (
    SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS mean_ownership
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY eventannotm
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT AVG(mean_ownership) AS overall_mean
    FROM timing_means
)
SELECT
    AVG(t.mean_ownership) AS mean_ownership,
    AVG(t.mean_ownership - c.overall_mean) AS mean_above_average
FROM timing_means AS t
CROSS JOIN comparison AS c
WHERE t.mean_ownership > c.overall_mean;

WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS overall_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL
),
timing_averages AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS timing_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT timing_avg, timing_avg - overall_avg AS difference
  FROM timing_averages
  CROSS JOIN baseline
  WHERE timing_avg > overall_avg
)
SELECT AVG(timing_avg) AS mean_ownership,
       AVG(difference) AS mean_above_average
FROM above_average

WITH timing_averages AS (
    SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
    FROM sentimentandfundamentals
    GROUP BY eventannotm
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ownership) AS overall_avg
    FROM timing_averages
    WHERE eventannotm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    AVG(t.avg_ownership) AS mean_ownership,
    AVG(t.avg_ownership - c.overall_avg) AS mean_above_average
FROM timing_averages AS t
CROSS JOIN comparison AS c
WHERE t.avg_ownership > c.overall_avg
